_comment: The curated model list. `name` is the exact Ollama name (registry.ollama.ai/library/<name>); sizes are the sum of the manifest's layers as the registry reported them on 2026-10-15 (they are shown to the user and used for the memory warning only; Ollama itself verifies every layer's SHA-256 while it pulls). Quantization and parameter count are from each model's config blob.

models.name: qwen2.5:0.5b
models.title: Qwen2.5 0.5B
models.note: The smallest one: quick to download and to answer, but simple. Good for trying the app.

models.name: gemma3:1b
models.title: Gemma 3 1B
models.note: Google's small model. Needs Ollama 0.30 or later (this app ships 0.35).

models.name: qwen2.5:1.5b
models.title: Qwen2.5 1.5B
models.note: A good balance of speed and quality for a few vCPUs.

models.name: qwen2.5:7b
models.title: Qwen2.5 7B
models.note: The best answers of the list. On the CPU it needs a VM of about 8 GB and answers slowly (tens of tokens per second at best).
